skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and differentiate land transfer mechanisms, financial aspects of land management, and dispute resolution processes.
Apply knowledge of land policies and laws to explain land management and usage processes.
Analyze real-world scenarios and apply appropriate land management strategies.
Work effectively in teams to solve land management issues.
Ensure adherence to legal frameworks in land management and transactions.
Manage financial aspects related to land transactions and valuation.
Handle and resolve land disputes effectively.
Analyze land market transactions and trends.
Conduct independent research and present findings effectively.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
